messages:
Maya (CS): quick sync — Oakmont private deploy day2. networking reported a failed KMS handshake when exporting audit logs to customer S3.
Tom (Infra): looking. can you paste the agent error or a log snippet? any CIDR mismatch?
Tom (Infra): also checking NAT flow logs now.
Maya (CS): logs show 403 from KMS: "AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01". customer says they rotated the key last week.
Karen (SE): if they rotated it they likely missed granting our redwood-service-role. did they run our grant helper? https://redwood.dev/priv/kms-grant
Maya (CS): customer admits they skipped the grant step due to restricted perms.
Leo (SecOps): that would cause the 403. we should advise creating a Grant or updating the key policy. Grant is better for future rotations.
Ashley (PM): what is the impact to go-live if we need the customer to grant access? any ETA?
Maya (CS): blocker = KMS grant + outgoing firewall to their splunk endpoint (10.12.3.45:443) is currently denied by their security posture.
Tom (Infra): i pushed a temporary NAT rule to allow outbound to splunk host for 72h (id: nat-72h-5991). this buys time for customer to apply the grant.
Tom (Infra): opened cloud provider support ticket #77421 to confirm cross-account re-encryption latency for large objects.
Karen (SE): sample minimal IAM policy for redwood-service-role to attach (send this to customer):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01"}
  ]
}
```
Maya (CS): forwarding to customer now. also flagging renewal risk: they mentioned renegotiating if go-live slips >2 weeks. tagging @Ashley for renewal ops.
Ashley (PM): acknowledged. i'll draft a short remediation plan + temporary credits proposal and loop legal if needed.
Leo (SecOps): one more: ensure CloudTrail includes KMS:ReEncrypt and PutObject events for their audit bucket and that the trail is logging keyId. otherwise we can't prove the sequence for their auditors.
Maya (CS): customer wants proof-of-access after we apply grant. plan: we run `aws kms generate-data-key --key-id <key>` then attempt a PutObject to their bucket and share logs.
Tom (Infra): will run validation after they confirm the grant and after NAT rule is live.
Maya (CS): filing a docs issue: make order-of-operations explicit — grant before rotate. small UX note.
Maya (CS): any preference on firewall scope? they suggested broad egress, i asked for narrower rule to the splunk host only. :thinking_face:
Leo (SecOps): prefer host/port only. narrower is auditable.
Tom (Infra): updated firewall to host 10.12.3.45 port 443 only. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deploy completed: audit-forwarder v2.4 -> prod-priv (build 8343)
Karen (SE): once customer confirms the grant, we schedule a 30m validation window and signoff.
Maya (CS): thanks all — i'll update the customer thread and close loop. :pray:
